question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"influence."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Influence"** means to have an effect on or sway someone or something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु में परिवर्तन लाने के लिए उस पर प्रभाव या शक्ति का उपयोग करना) • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of the sentence. • **Example:** *She tried to **influence**__ her friend's decision by showing her all the benefits of studying abroad.* • *​*The passage says that the healthcare sector can have an impact on the economy. • The correct answer is Option 3. • Correct passage: The world is going through a deep recession. At such a time, one thing we need in abundance is jobs for the semi-skilled and unskilled. This is the only way in which equal __distribution__ of wealth can take place. The healthcare industry is ideally poised to occupy this position. The IT industry hires people from the upper-middle strata and rich families, usually engineers, __whereas__ the health care industry hires nurses, to the tune of eighty per cent of the jobs created, from the lower economic strata. Global health care is a 4.5-trillion rupee industry, second only to the agro-industry. Even then, health care __reaches__ only eight per cent of the world's population. Policymakers should look at the healthcare industry as not only an industry which addresses pain but also as one which can __**influence**__ the economy. The last century was driven by machines that addressed human toil and it is strongly believed that this century will be driven by health care. This, however, will only happen if policymakers make a conscious effort to ______ (5) ______ the right policies in place soon. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Impede"** means to obstruct or hinder the progress of something/someone. (व्‍यकि्त या वस्‍तु के लिए हिलने-डुलने या आगे बढ़ने में कठिनाई उपस्थित करना, बाधा या अड़चन डालना) • **"Persuade"** means to convince someone to do or believe something. (समझा-बुझाकर किसी को काम के लिए राज़ी करना, मनाना) • **"Ascertain"** means to find out or determine something with certainty. (कुछ पता लगाना) 4b:T11cb, The correct answer is **"put."**
